versions.changelog:
- Added project homepage link to metadata and setup instructions.
- Replaced detailed installation steps with a reference to the project homepage.
- No changes to features or functionality.

Major update: Demo and support files removed, with new privacy clarifications in documentation.

- Removed 26 files, including all demo projects, templates, scripts, and supporting documentation.
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify privacy protections and data handling practices.
- SKILL.md now explicitly states that all user documents stay local and no client data is included in the repository.
- Added explanation of how Claude processes instructions and data, referencing Anthropic's usage policy.

Version 1.0.1

- Simplified and clarified the SKILL.md documentation for broader usability.
- Added distinct "What It Does", "Who It's For", and "How It Works" sections for easier onboarding.
- Streamlined setup instructions and explained the project workflow at a high level.
- Highlighted privacy: all processing runs locally; no client data is saved in the repo.
- Detailed template pack types and encouraged custom template creation.
- Removed deep technical and internal implementation details to focus on user-facing features.

Appraisal-AI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces an end-to-end automated appraisal report drafting pipeline.
- Scans workfiles (PDFs, deeds, assessor cards, CoStar reports) to extract structured data.
- Generates Word narrative drafts with tracked changes and Excel adjustment grids from master templates.
- Supports land-only, improved, condemnation, and custom template packs.
- Enforces critical rules such as tracked changes for all Word edits and non-destructive Excel operations.
- Outlines full 5-phase workflow using multiple agents for extraction, drafting, review, and compliance.
